_comment: NOTE: The entries below are demo data only. Replace them with the actual breaking changes of each release.
Each entry is keyed by its JIRA issue key and holds:
title: short description displayed in the pop-up window
releases: first release per release line that includes the change, e.g. ["2.7.9", "2.8.5", "2.9.1"] for a change backported to 2.7 and 2.8
permissions: the pop-up window is displayed to users who are assigned at least one of these permissions, e.g. sos:products:joc:administration:settings:manage
